```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # Split only at the first '='
print(parts)                 # Output: ['hello', 'good=']
```

Using `maxsplit=1` tells Python to perform at most one split, so everything after the first `=` stays together (including any trailing `=`).
